rows.isolates: Read + Apply for the principal: applies, and wins the conflict at order 1
Read WITHOUT Apply: the principal can see the GPO and must not receive it. ReadOnlyOnly must be ABSENT
Apply granted to a GROUP the principal belongs to: applies through the token. NestedOnly must be present
CONTROL: default Authenticated Users Read+Apply, unconflicted. Absent => the experiment did not run, and every absence above means nothing.
